{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too high - true outcomes consistently lag behind and are 1-3 points lower than forecasts",
    "Forecasts show less volatility than true outcomes, especially in the first 10-15 day horizon",
    "Sentiment positivity correlates with slightly higher forecast values but model doesn't fully capture sentiment-driven volatility",
    "The gap between model forecasts and true outcomes increases in the first 10 days, then narrows to a consistent 1-3 point downward bias",
    "When history shows price decline, model under-forecasts the decline by approximately 2-4 points",
    "Sentiment turning negative (below 0) correlates with model being approximately 2-3 points too high",
    "Model fails to capture the mean-reversion peak around day 8-10 where true outcomes reach a local maximum before continuing the downward trend"
] }
